tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lam zab sbas don snying po bzhugs so// mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po'i bcud/ /dad dang bsod nams las 'phro'i mthus/ /'dod dgu'i dpal yon stsol ba'i thabs/ /zab mo lam gyi sgrub pa bshad/ /ces brjod nas/ 'dir gsang ba'i lam zab 'chag med nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos… 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la… ci mang bzlas mthar/ bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum la/ /snying nas skyabs su mchi lags kyis/ /deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mi 'bral rjes su 'dzin par mdzod/ /ces brjod la skyabs yul rang la bstim/ ma gyur 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /lam zab snying po blang bar bgyi'o/ /sems bskyed lan gsum/ drin can pha ma 'gro ba yongs/ /bde dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal bral/ /nam yang bde dang mi 'bral bar/ /tshad med btang snyoms gnas par shog /ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rgyan rta babs dang bcas mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma zla ba bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gang sku'i cha shas phung khams skye mched thams cad/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu ste gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha'i ngo bor bzhugs pa de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po gsum yang gdan pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa 'od zer dang gzi brjid kun nas 'bar bar gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang nas bka' drin mtshungs bral blo gsal rgya mtsho'i bar gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / gzhan yang yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ mkha' 'gro chos srung / tshe lha nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkha' oṃ badz+ra sa ma dza/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs bla ma'i mtshan bstod ci shes pas bstod/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ji ltar bsam pa'i bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bla ma so so'i mtshan nas smos pa'i gsol ba drag tu gdab/ lha dges pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rgyud smin par byed pa drin gyi mchog /drin dran pa'i mod la gsol ba 'debs/ /yid ci bsam dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /zhes kyang yang yang brjod/ de nas zhen pa spang ba ni/ longs spyod phul bar bsam la/ tshe thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /stong 'khor los bsgyur dang bran khol sogs/ /rdzas bdag gir bgyis pa'i longs spyod kun/ /rgyud tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir khyod la 'bul/ /dgra gnyen thams cad phul bar bsam la/ sems chags sdang rmongs gsum skye ba'i rgyu/ /khong dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba kun/ /skyabs bla ma'i bran du phul ba 'dis/ /sems chags sdang bral bar mdzad du gsol/ /rang lus kyang bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas phul bar bsam la/ sems thog med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu/ /lus gces par bzung ba'i phung khrol rnams/ /mgron 'khor 'das kun la mchod pa 'bul/ /thugs dges pa chen pos bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyas par na/ mgron rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du 'bul sogs so so la sbyar/

dngos grub blang ba ni/ 'dren mchog bla ma dam pa'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ bdag gi dpral bar thim/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ snang stong gi ting nge 'dzin skyes/ sku rdo rje'i dngos grub thob/ mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ mgrin par thim/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin skyes/ gsung rdo rje'i dngos grub thob/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ snying kar thim/ yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skyes/ thugs rdo rje'i dngos grub thob/ bla ma'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum las/ yig 'bru dkar dmar mthing gsum/ bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rgyun 'dzag pa/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phro ba dang bcas pa gcig car spros/ bdag gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus kyi nang thams cad khyab/ yi ge bdud rtsi 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis lus thams cad gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ bde stong lhan skyes kyi ting nge 'dzin skyes/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje dbyer med pa mchog gi dngos grub thob/ bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs ma lus par zhugs pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i rdo rje rnam bzhi'i dngos/ /'bru gsum dwangs ma re re cig car ba/ /gnas gsum lus sems kun la thim pa'i mod/ /sku bzhi mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa ni/ de ltar de dag thim pa'i mod la/ rang sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gdod ma nas dri mas dag pa'i steng du/ glo bur gyi dri ma'i cha shas cung zad dag dwangs snyigs phyed pa'i gsal stong zung 'jug la mnyam par bzhag pa yun ring du bya/ gdod nas rnam dag lhan skyes ye shes che/

/dam pa'i drin las skad cig shar ba des/ /gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i dri ma rtsad nas bcad/ /g.yo med 'od gsal ngang la lhug par gnas/ /chos zab dgu'i snying po bsdus pa'i bcud/ /lam zab mo bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /snying pad+ma bzhad pa'i ge sar rtser/ /dpal ngo mtshar ro bcud smin par shog /rigs kun bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /yum rab dga' rdo rje bdag med ma/ /lam 'khrul med paṇa grub bi rū pa/ /yid som nyi spangs nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bod gangs can 'dren pa sa skya pa/ /sku 'ja' lus mngon gyur bsod nams rtse/ /rgyud man ngag kun bdag grags pa'i zhabs/ /yid som nyi… nang bla ma'i rnal 'byor thugs la smin/ /phyi shes bya kun la thogs pa med/ /skyabs bslu med sa skya paṇ+ḍi tar/ /yid som nyi… bod khams gsum dbang bsgyur 'phags pa'i mtshan/ /nyams rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag tshogs sgom pa/ /thugs mkhyen brtse nus ldan nyan chen pa/ /yid som nyi… chos sgrub la rtse gcig brag phug pa/ /lha 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos pu ṇ+ye shri/ /dpal snyan grags kun khyab tshul khrims zhabs/ /yid som nyi… rje grub pa'i dbang phyug bud+dha shrī/ /mgon rgyal bas lung bstan e waṃ pa/ /yongs bstan pa'i srog shing sems dpa' che/ /yid som nyi… lugs brgyud pa gsum ldan bdag chen rje/ /skyabs sbas pa'i grub chen kun spangs zhabs/ /yid som nyi… drin 'gran zla kun bral tshar pa rje/ /chos brgyad khri'i mnga' bdag kun dga'i mtshan/ /lung rigs pa'i dbang phyug ma ti'i zhabs/ /chos slob bshad bka' babs klu sgrub rje/ /yid som nyi… sku mtshan dpe'i lang tsho dar la smin/ /gsung snyan pa'i rgyud mangs phyogs brgyar sgrogs/ /thugs mkhyen brtse'i ba dan lhab lhub g.yo/ /rje bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems rtse gcig snying stobs dang ba'i mthus/ /skyabs bslu med mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'di phyi gnas skabs thams cad du/

/rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /tshe bsod nams rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /lam zab mo bla ma'i byin rlabs 'di/ /thugs dad ldan bsod nams dar chen gyis/ /dus lan gcig min par gsol ba'i mthus/ /don ci bsam 'grub pa'i thabs su sbyar/ /de ltar lam zab gnad kyi snying po dril ba'i nyams len 'di ni/ dad dang 'dun par ldan pa'i mang mkhar khab pa bsod nams dar chen pas yang yang bskul ba las/ lam zab mo'i rnal 'byor pa rig pa 'dzin pa nā gardzu nas sbyar ba'o// ༈ //lam zab nang gi nyams len byin rlabs kyi pho nya zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ngo mtshar rmad byung dam pa'i chos kyi sgo/ /srid dang zhi ba'i dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus drin can bla ma la/ /mgrin pa las gzhan snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /'khon rigs 'jam pa'i rdo rje yis/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mngon sum zhal/ /bka' lung gcig tu bgros pa yi/ /lam zab nang gi rnal 'byor bshad/ /de ltar brjod nas/ zab mo nang gi lam zab nyams len la/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang skad cig gis kye rdor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i dges pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma brgyud pa yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mchod/ sna tshogs me tog phon po bdug spos sprin/ /mar me'i phreng ba dri zhim spos chu'i char/ /ro ldan zhal zas yid 'ong rol mo'i sgra/ /mchod par 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ mchod pa'i zhing 'od du zhu rang la thim pas/ rang gi lus rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba ni/

spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsibs ma rdo rje'i rwa ba/ lpags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ ba spu mda'i dra ba/ sen mo me ri 'bar ba ste srung ba'i 'khor lo/ rkang mthil rlung / sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ka sa/ rgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ga nas 'byung bzhi'i rlung sgo bzhi/ mig pañtsa re kha'i rtsig pa/ sna rin po che'i pha gu/ so dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa/ lce dang mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rna ba rta bab/ rkang rnams ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lte ba'i aṃ rin chen 'byung ldan gser btso ma lta bu/ gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte ba'i ha don yod grub pa mar gad ltar ljang ba/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hūm̐ mi bskyod pa baiḍūr+ya'i zhun ma lta bu/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte bar oṃ 'od dpag med mtshams sprin ltar yangs pa/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte bar haṃ rnam par snang mdzad chu shel ltar 'od 'phro ba/ de lnga ka'ang / phung po lnga dang / dug lnga gnas su dag pa/ ye shes lnga dang rigs lnga'i rang gzugs mtshan dpes spras pa/ 'byung ba lnga dag pa'i rang mtshungs kyi shes rab ma dang mnyam par sbyar/ yum mtshungs kyi lha mo rtsa 'dab kyi grangs dang mnyam pas 'ja' ris ltar bskor ba/ mig tu sa snying gzugs rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ rna bar phyag rdor sgra rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ snar nam snying dri rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ lcer 'jig rten dbang phyug ro rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ lus la sgrib pa rnam sel reg rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ yid la kun bzang chos dbyings rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/

lag pa g.yas par gshin rje gshed/ g.yon par shes rab mthar byed/ lcer mthar byed/ gsang gnas su bgegs mthar byed/ dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba/ g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can/ g.yon par stobs po che/ spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ rkang mthil du gnod mdzes rnams kyang rang 'od kyi shes rab ma dang mnyam par sbyar ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyang ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma/ rnam pa bde ba/ rang bzhin gsal stong / ngo bo zung 'jug gzhan yang lus rtsa sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa yi ge longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khams bdud rtsi chos kyi sku/ snying po ye shes kyi rlung ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ gdod ma nas lhun gyis grub pa'i rten dang brten pa sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ de nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du dges pa rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i sku can du gsal ba'i spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam pa can/ de'i spyi bor dbus su bka' drin mtshungs bral blo gsal rgya mtsho/ g.yas su 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo/ g.yon du 'jam mgon phyogs las rnam rgyal gsum yang dges pa rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam pa can/ de'i spyi gtsug nar mtho brtsegs rim bzhin/ rdo ring kun spangs chos kyi nyi ma nas/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po/ mus chen/ ngor chen/ bud+dha shrī/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje bla ma/ brag phug pa/ zhang pa/ 'phags pa/ sa paṇa/ rje btsun pa/ slob dpon rin po che/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ grub chen rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po rnams kyang dges mdzad rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can/

sku lus la lus dkyil gyi lha rten dang brten pa dang bcas par gyur/ ces gsal btab/ de la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /dbang bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes dang / ngo mtshar rmad byung rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /rnyog med phul phyin dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes zla med dbang bzhi'i chu bo'i rgyun/ /lus sems rab dga'i bde chen bstsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ sangs rgyas dges mdzad yab yum 'od du zhu/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug la dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis thim ste bla ma rnams 'og ma rnams la rim bzhin thim/ mthar kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma dges mdzad yab yum 'od du zhu ba/ dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun 'od kyi gong bu cha gsum du gyur pa/ mtshungs bral 'dren pa rnam gsum gyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu khar thim/ smin mtshams yan chad gang bas bum dbang / mgrin pa yan chad gang bas gsang dbang / snying ga yan chad gang bas sher dbang / zhabs mthil yan chad gang bas dbang bzhi pa ste/ dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun gyis sku lus thams cad gang / slar yang drin can bla ma rnam gsum la gsol ba btab pas/ g.yas kyi bla ma dges mdzad 'od du zhu/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis thim/ g.yon gyi bla ma dges mdzad 'od du zhu/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis thim/ slar yang khyad par gyi gsol gdab ni/ tshe thog med rnam dkar las kyis sbrel/ /drin 'khor med mkhyen brtse'i phyag gis bskyangs/ /mchog 'dren pa blo gsal rgya mtsho yis/ /dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes brjod pas/ drin can blo gsal rgya mtsho dges mdzad yab yum 'od du zhu/ rtsa ba'i bla ma spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu khar thim/ smin mtshams yan chad gang bas/

bum pa'i dbang sogs dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun gyis sku gang ste/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid/ bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs kun 'dus/ yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems/ tshe lha nor lha bka' srung rgya mtsho'i dngos grub kun 'dus kyi gdan gsum tshang ba'i yi dam gyi ngo bor gyur/ de nas/ byin rlabs kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma yis/ /bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur bstsal du gsol/ /dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun dpal ldan bla ma yis/ /bdag… 'phrin las kun khyab… dngos grub kun 'byung… zhes gsol ba btab pas spyi gtsug gi bla ma dges mdzad snyoms par zhugs pa'i sku rdo rje'i dbang gi chu rgyun dang / bde chen 'khor lo'i bla ma rnam snang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dbang gi chu rgyun dkar pos/ smin mtshams yan chad gang / lus kyi dri ma dag lus sku rdo rjer gyur/ snang stong gi ye shes rang byung du shar bas spyir bum pa'i dbang thob/ khyad par spyi bo'i bla ma rnam snang 'khor bcas gsal thebs te mos gus chud pa bum dbang gi bum dbang / rlung sbyor bas lus bde drod du 'bar ba bum dbang gi gsang dbang / rnam snang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyis/ smin mtshams yan gyi rtsa thams cad khyab pas sems la rab dga' shar ba bum dbang gi sher dbang / de ltar shar bas rang sems lhan skyes gsal stong zung 'jug blo bur rnyog mas dag pa bum dbang bzhi pa ste/ bum dbang gis bsdus pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ yang rtsa ba'i bla ma la gong gsol gdab/ 'don pa bsgyur te gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ spyi gtsug gi bla ma dges mdzad yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i gsung rdo rje'i dbang gi chu rgyun dang / mgrin pa'i bla ma 'od dpag med snyoms par zhugs pa'i dbang gi chu rgyun dmar pos mgrin pa yan chad gang / ngag gi dri ma dag ngag gsung rdo rjer gyur/

mgrin par gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin rang shar du byung bas spyir gsang ba'i dbang thob/ khyad par mgrin pa'i bla ma 'od dpag med yab yum gsal theb ste/ mos gus chud pa gsang dbang gi bum dbang / rlung gi sbyor bas lus bde stong drod du 'bar ba gsang dbang gi gsang dbang / 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyis mgrin pa yan chad kyi rtsa gnas thams cad la khyab pas/ sems la mchog dga' shar ba gsang dbang gi sher dbang / de ltar shar bas rang sems lhan skyes gsal stong rnyog mas dwangs pa gsang dbang gi bzhi ba thob pa yin no zhes brjod do/ /yang sngar bzhin/ byin rlabs kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma yis/ /bdag la gsum pa'i dbang bskur bstsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab/ spyi gtsug gi bla ma dges mdzad yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas thugs rdo rje'i dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun dang / chos kyi 'khor lo'i bla ma mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dbang gi chu rgyun sngon pos snying kha yan gang / sems kyi dri ma dag yid thugs rdo rjer gyur/ sems la bde stong ye shes rang shar du byung bas sher dbang thob/ khyad par du/ snying ga'i bla ma mi bskyod pa 'khor bcas gsal theb ste mos gus chud pa gsum pa'i bum dbang / rlung gi sbyor bas lus la bde drod 'bar ba gsum pa'i gsang dbang / mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems snying ga yan chad kyi rtsa gnas thams cad la khyab pas sems la dga' bral ting nge 'dzin rang shar du byung ba gsum pa'i sher dbang / de ltar shar bas rang sems lhan skyes gsal stong gzung 'dzin gyi rnyog mas dwangs pa gsum pa'i dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ yang dbang bzhi pa'i don du/ byin rlabs kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma yis/ /bdag la mchog dbang bzhi pa bstsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab/ spyi gtsug gi bla ma dges mdzad yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum zhu ba'i dbang gi chu rgyun dang /

lte gsang gi bla ma rin 'byung yab yum dang / don grub yab yum dang / mig sogs kyi byang sems yab yum/ tshogs kyi khro bo bcu yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dbang gi chu rgyun dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis/ rkang mthil yan chad kyi lus phyi nang thams cad gang / lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum dang ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ khyad par lte gsang sogs bla ma rin 'byung yab yum don grub yab yum/ byang sems yab yum khro bcu yab yum gsal theb/ rang lus bla ma gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs la mos gus tshud pas dbang bzhi pa'i bum dbang / rlung gi sbyor bas lus thams cad bde drod du 'bar ba bzhi pa'i gsang dbang / lte gsang sogs lha yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems kyis lus yongs rdzogs kyi rtsa gnas thams cad khyab/ sems lhan skyes rang shar du byung ba bzhi pa'i sher dbang / de lta bus rang sems gdod ma nas lhan skyes kyi ye shes/ blo bur sgrib g.yog bsal ba'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa'i gnas lugs la gsal snang thob pa'i yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i bzhi pa ste/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa yin no zhes brjod de/ gshis brjod bral mos gus kyi rang mdangs sa le ba la mnyam par bzhag pa yun ring du bya/ phyi bla mar mi phyed dad pa rgyas/ /nang rdo rje'i lus kun bla mar shar/ /sems bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med 'dres/ /ci bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par shog /rje 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung bla ma rje/ /rdzas don yod mchod sprin phung por spungs/ /ngag don yod bstod dbyangs snying po bzlas/ /lus don yod snying po longs par shog /ces dang / chos bzhin sa skyong phan dgongs lhun gyis grub/ /dngos grub bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i za ma tog /byin rlabs cho ga klu sgrub bdag gis phul/

/ces nang lam zab ngag 'don ut+pa la'i phreng ba 'di ni/ chos bzhin skyong ba'i mi dbang mchog gi bka' mchid gser gyi skud pas drangs pa las shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa nā gardzu nas 'dar chos 'khor yang rtse'i skyed tshal du sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis/ 'dis slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin skyong ba'i sbyin bdag dang bcas pa zla ba 'phan bcas ltar dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /yi ge pa ni gnyos ban sger bu pa// ༈ //nang gi lam zab kyi brgyud 'debs lam rim dang bcas pa sbas don snying gi kha 'byed bzhugs so/ /bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthar thug dwangs ma lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang / /'ja' ris ye shes lnga dngos bdag med ma/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor las grol bi rū pa/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bi rūs dngos su zhal 'doms sa skya pa/ /rdzu 'phrul gar gyis rol mkhas bsod nams rtse/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bka' babs grags pa'i zhabs/ /snying nas… lnga rig 'jam pa'i rdo rje paṇ+ḍi ta/ /rtsa rlung nus pa mthar phyin tshogs sgom pa/ /'gyur med byang sems brtan pa'i nyan chen zhabs/ /snying nas… nyams rtogs 'od gsal 'byongs pa'i brag phug pa/ /'khon rigs 'jam dbyangs ngo bo dam pa'i zhabs/ /snyan brgyud bzhis gdams dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ /snying nas… tshad ma bzhi ldan grub chen bud+dha shrī/ /'khrul med rgyal bas lung bstan e waṃ pa/ /gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mus chen zhabs/ /snying nas… slob bshad lam gyi bka' babs bdag chen rje/ /'khrul med brgyud 'dzin rdo ring kun spangs zhabs/ /nges don gsung ngag 'chad mkhas bla chen tshar/ /snying nas… zab yangs chos kun rang grol kun dga'i mtshan/ /bka' drin zla med 'jam mgon skyid gshongs pa/ /gsung ngag gnad la yid ches klu sgrub zhabs/ /snying nas… tshad ma bzhi ldan snyan brgyud bzhis gdams pa'i/ /dbang khrid byin rlabs bshad rgyun man ngag gnad/

/gces par 'dzin pa drin can bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ci bsam dngos grub stsol// ༈ //gsung ngag gnad kyi be'u bum las dus tha ma'i cho ga gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i lag len bzhugs so/ /tshig khrid gnad la blo gsal mkhas pa'i gtso/ /nyams khrid gnad la grub rig rgya mtsho'i mgon/ /lag khrid gnad la mkhas btsun grags pa'i dpal/ /phrin las rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur mdzes la 'dud/ /'di na dus mthas gtugs pa'i sems can 'ga'/ /dges mchog rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bcug nas rjes bzung sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i tshul/ /dus mtha'i cho ga bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri/ /de la 'dir/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i phyag srol las byon pa/ kyaiḥrdo rje pa'i lugs kyi dus mtha' ma'i cho ga ni rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa gzhan phan bdud rtsir grags pa 'di nyid yin la/ 'di la'ang tshig sna ring thung gi dpe gnyis tsam snang ba las/ tshig sna ring ba ni/ rgyud sde 'og ma nas byon pa'i thun mong ba'i mgron 'dir bos te/ bcug pas bcud cuṃng zadaṃ myong pa zhig snang gsungs/ rgyud pa 'di pas tshad mar bya rgyud ni/ tshig sna cung zad thung zhing kha gtsang ba de nyid yin zhing / 'di'i yig sna cung zad mthud dgos pa ni/ rje pa'i bde mchog dus tha ma'i cho ga dang / zhang dkon mchog dpal gyi 'di nyid kyi dus mtha'i gsal byed du bshad pa ji ltar 'os pa rje bla ma'i zhal shes kyis brgyan nas lag khrid du ston par mdzad pa yin no/ /de yang 'di'i rtsa ba ni gsum ste/ dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyong ba/ rje ngor pa'i yongs 'dzin shar chen pas 'di'i gsal byed yod na/ gzhan phan bdud rtsi nyid bogs thon par med gsungs/ ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyong ba/ mchod rten byas te sdig pa sbyong ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum mo/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ bsnyen pa/ sa chog sta gon/ dngos gzhi/ dang po ni/

ji ltar 'os pa'i gnas der/ bdag nyid yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bar bya ste/ mdun du las bum bshams/ dbang chu'i las bum gyi bskyed chog 'dir bkod nas byas pa sa chog gsung ngo / /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yan lag bzhi'i cho ga bzhin bskyed de/ hūm̐ ngam a mri ta sngon 'gro'i chu bzhi sogs kyis mchod/ nang mchod yid byung sogs kyis mchod cing / khyod ni rnal 'byor sogs kyi bstod thung ngam/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges zhes sogs kyis bstod cing / a mri ta dang / a bhi ṣe ka sogs kyis bzlas pa mi nyung ba tsam byas/ de nas ro de nyid la sbyang ba rnam pa gsum bya ste/ bum chu des a mri ta bzla bzhin pas ro legs par bkru/ sbyong rgyud nas bshad pa'i bdag yig ji snyed bzhi sogs 'don par bzhed pa la/ gnas nyer bzhir ji skad bshad pa bzhin 'dod gsungs/ de nas bdag yig 'dogs pa ni/ nor bu la bris pa'i rtsa sngags dang a spyi bor snying po dang ā mgrin par nye snying dang hūm̐/ snying gar/ phreng sngags dang / 'khor gyi sngags rnams lte bar 'dogs pa yin/ 'bri ba'i tshul ni bcad gtubs ma yin par tal mar thal yug tu sngags rang gi mjug rdzogs par bris pa'i dbus kyi steng thad la/ 'bru gsum po so sor 'bri zhing / dri bzang gis bltab par bya'o/ /'dogs pa'i tshul ni/ so so'i thad kyi sha la sbyor ba'am/ min na nang dbu nas dril te bsraṃs spruṃs breṃl nas so so la btags pa'am/ min na rten ras kyis dril te/ so so'i thad kyi ras la byed pa'ang mthong gsung ngo / / de nas rten de nyid sgrom du bcug ste rten de'i mdun du chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i mchod pa tshang ba bshams shing sbyor ba dang ldan na tshad med pa bshams pas chog mchod rten gyi rnam pa ji ltar 'os pa bya ste/ bsnyen pa dngos la 'jug pa yin no/ /ji ltar 'jug ni/ rten de nyid dbang thob yin min gyi dbye bas 'di la gnyis te/

ro mchod gnas ltar sbyong ba dang / ro sbyin bdag ltar sbyong ba'o/ /dang po ro de nyid a mṛ tas/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su bh+rūm̐ las rnam snang kyai rdo rje yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis bskyed/ phyi nang yid byung gis mchod cing / bstod thung ngam/ rnam par snang mdzad dag pa ches bstod la/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng las 'od 'phros te/ rten gyi thugs ka'i bh+rum̐ la phog de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rang gnas su thim pa tsam bya/ 'od zer gyi sna la mchod pa'i sprin dpung sprul te/ rten lha'i rang bzhin mchod pas mnyes par bya ba'i dmigs pa la'ang bya'o/ /de nas zhag bdun gyi nges pas kha gso ba'i bsnyen pa tshang bar byed na/ thun re bzhin bdag gi rnal 'byor dang / mchod gtor rten gyi bskyed chog rnams tshang bar bya ste rdzogs par bya'o/ /'di'i sngags kyi sdeṃ laṃ tshig 'bru gsum la mdzad pa zhig ston snyam na/ de tsam ma grub na snying po tsam gyis sam/ de tsam yang thog ma'i thun der bzlas pa dkyus las mi nyung ba zhig tu dmigs pa brtan pas bzla ba'o/ /gnyis pa ltar na gzhan gyi khyad par med la ro de nyid lhar bskyed pa la mi dbang bas/ de'i spyi bor rnam snang sngar bzhin bskyed la/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa/ 'di dag gi tshe gzungs thag la gtad la bzlas zhes gzhan phan bdud rtsi rang na gsungs so/ /rnam snang gi thugs ka'i bh+ruṃ las 'od zer byung ste/ 'og gi chu yi dkyil 'khor la phog pas ye shes kyi rang bzhin zag med kyi chu'i rgyun nar gyis byung / ruṃs bu'i spyi bo nas babs pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad bsangs shing sbyangs par bsam la bzlas pa bya'o/ /gnyis pa sa chog ni/ cho ga rgyas bsdus ni/ ci rigs pa dbang chu bzhin zhes dkyus na'o/

/gsum pa sta gon la'ang sa lha/ lha/ bum pa sta gon dang gsum tshe ldan bzhin la/ slob ma sta gon gyi sngon du/ rten bskyed pa/ rnam shes dgug pa/ bgegs sbyangs pa/ sdig pa sbyangs pa rnams byas la/ lhag ma tshe ldan bzhin bya zhing / rjes zlos nye 'brel lam/ byas par bsam pas kyang chog go /zhes dkyus na'o/ /bzhi pa dngos gzhi la/ thig bri na/ tshon gyis bri ba/ mtshan ma 'god pa/ rgyan dgram pa/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ bdag 'jug gi bar du bya zhes dkyus na'o/ /slob ma tshe 'das gzhug pa'i phyir/ thog mar rten bskyed pa ni/ las kyi rdo rjes rten sbyang ba la thugs gtad pa zhu zhes brjod ces gsungs so/ /a mri tas bsang zhing / swa bha was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lhor sbyong stegs kyi steng du ṇi las tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i phung po dang / khams dang skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ ces bskyed cing / de yang tha mal pa ni/ tha mal kyi rnam pa nyid du bskyed la/ dbang thob pa yin na/ lha'i rnam par bskyed gsungs so/ /de nas rnam shes dgug pa/ bgegs skrod pa'i tshe rgyuṃ dang / gshin po dgug pa'i tshe na mo dang / dgra bo sgrol ba'i tshe jiṃ naṃ 'dren byed pa gsang sngags gaṃng yin gsungs/ dkyus dag go rim du 'di bzhin med na'ang / gsang sngags bla ma nyid gtso bor byed pa la 'di bzhin 'thad gsungs/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi… chos kyi… dge 'dun gyi… bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlob kyi/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba khams gsum gang na gnas kyang skad cig la 'dir mchis par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gau ri nas/ ho'i bar lan gsum gyis ting 'dzin sngags rgyas dgug pa'o/

de nas bgegs sbyang ba ni/ thog mar/ gtor ma gsum rten la g.yas su bskor zhing / oṃ sarba big nan na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo ces sogs lan gsum brjod pa ni/ zhi bas sbyang ba ste/ gsang sngags gnyis ka zhi ba yin pas so/ yang bting lo dang chang bu'ang g.yas su skor zhing / oṃ sum+bha ni sogs lan gsum brjod pa ni/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba ste rdzas zhi ba/ sngags drag po yin pas so/ /de ltar brjod rjes tshe las 'das pa che ge mo la gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing / gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar chad byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma 'di lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces brjod/ de nas drag pos sbyang ba la/ skabs 'dir khro bo spyan 'dren ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med/ byas kyang zhang pas bshad pas mi rung ba med gsungs te/ gang ltar/ de nas gong ltar rje btsun sogs nas byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas/ des tshim par gyis la sa phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas par bya'o/ /zhes brjod la rten gu gul gyis bdugs/ yungs kar gyis brab/ rol mo'i sgra rab tu bya zhing / rtsa sngags sna tshogs khro bo'i sngags mang du brjod pa ni/ drag po'i sbyang ba ste/ rdzas sngags gnyis ka drag po yin pas so/ /de nas sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig pa thams cad kaṃ nag gi rnam pas sna bug nas thon/

sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pas til la thim pa de g.yas su me g.yon du chur dor bas/ sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍa ki ni kha kha/ kha hī kha hī sarba pā paṃ da ha na bha smin ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'i til sngags brjod cing mer bsreg chur dor/ de nas yig brgya/ rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying sogs brjod cing / 'bru 'am/ yungs dkar ram/ bye mas brab bo/ /de nas dri ma sbyang tshul 'dir ma bshad pas ma byas kyang chog la/ rje pas bde mchog gi dus mtha' mar bshad pas byas kyang 'gal ba med pas/ khrus gsol nas phyin drug gi shis brjod byas nas/ de nas dkon mchog gsum gyi bden tshig 'byung bzhi'i bden tshig sogs kyang zhang pas bshad pa ltar bya rung ba yin la/ de nas shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa ltar byas nas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshe/ gang drin ma dang / thams cad dngos po sogs byas la/ gtso bo rgyal ba sogs/ spyod 'jug nas 'byung ba'ang / rang blo'i 'jug yul rtagaṃs pas chog pa yin no/ /de nas ni slob ma 'jug pa'i cho ga bya ste/ bdag med ma yi mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sdom pa bsgrags pa/ sems bskyed dang / rigs lnga'i sdom bzung / gdong g.yos bcing / me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ bum chu bran/ 'dod pa dri zhing lan gdab/ kun rdzob sems bskyed dam/ yol ba'i phyir dam la bzhag pa ste/ yol ba'i phyir bya ba dang / de nas yol ba'i nang du bcug dam bzhag bzhi/ ye shes dbab pa gsol ba dang / bcas pa brtan par bya ba/ me tog phreng ba dor ba/ mgo la bcings pa/ gdong g.yog phye ba/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa/ ched du brjod pa bya ba ste 'jug pa'o/ /de nas dbang gi don du gsol ba btab/ shis brjod bya/ rigs pa'i dbang lnga/ slob dpon gyi man ngag rjes gnang / lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod rnams bya zhing / sngar dbang thob yin na gong ma gsum yang bskur ro/

/de nas dam tshig gis bsdus te khas blangs/ yon phul/ rtogs skyed sogs byas la/ tshogs dang 'brel ba'i gtor ma btang la/ tshogs 'khor bya'o/ /tshogs 'khor bya ba'i skabs ni/ slob dpon gyis bdag 'jug tshar ba'i rjes la'ang rung la/ slob ma'i bya ba tshar ba'i rjes 'dir yang rung zhes bdud rtsi rang na'o/ /slob ma lhar bskyed yod pas tshogs kyi skal ba drangs nas/ de la chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod/ nang mchod yid 'byung / khyod ni rnal 'byor sogs kyis bstod nas/ lam sbyang bstan bya ste/ de la sbyang ba ni/ tshogs lam smig rgyu lta bu ste/ /gnyis pa du ba lta bu yin/ /gsum pa glog ltar khyod kyis mthong / /bzhi pa mar me lta bu ste/ /lnga pa thams cad stong pa yin/ /sangs rgyas sa ni 'di nyid de/ /srid pa bar do 'di nyid do/ /khyod kyis lam lnga mthar phyin shog /ces pa'o/ /lam bstan pa ni/ khyod kyis lam lnga mthar phyin pas/ /phung po lnga ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /nyon mongs lnga ni mkha' 'gro lnga/ /rnam shes brgyad ni ye shes lnga/ /'byung ba bzhi ni lha mo bzhi/ /srid pa'i 'khor ba rgyun bcad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ lam sbyang bstan gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag ni/ rgyud brgya pa'i tshig yin no zhes bram ze nag po zhabs kyi gzhung las 'byung ngo zhes bdud rtsi rang na gzhung 'di'i rgyud dang man ngag gnyis char du tshogs rgyab dang bstan pa yin no/ /zhes pa'o/ /de nas ni lhag gtor sogs mjug gi bya ba rdzogs par bya'o/ /gal te zhag bdun phrag gsum dang bdun la sogs pa byed na'ang / bdun phrag re re song ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba btab cing dngos grub blangs nas gshegs su gsol/ de'i tshe nyin re bzhin la thun bzhir bcad la/ thor thun sogs gsum la/ bdag bskyed sngon du song nas/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la gsal gdab/ mchod bstod bya zhing /

bzlas pa byas nas gsol ba gdab/ slob ma'i bya ba mi dgos so/ /byed na'ang dgug pa nas bzung ste/ sdom pa 'bogs pa'i bar bya/ kha zas tshogs 'khor gyi tshul du byas la lhag ma'i bar bya/ srod thun la ni thams cad bya'o/ /zhes bdud rtsi rang na bzhugs so/ /rdul tshon phyags te chu bor dor ba sogs mjug chog rdzogs par bya/ tho rangs kyi cha la mjug chog rdzogs par byed pa ni thun dang po mdor na nub gcig dngos gzhi nub drug la lha mi gshegs pa nub bdun du 'gro bas bdun tshigs zhes bya'o/ /ngan song sbyong rgyud la zhag bdun du dkyil 'khor 'dir zhag bdun du nges pa ni/ zhag bdun du dbang bskur na sdig pa las grol ba'i don gyis yin gyi/ bar do zhag bdun 'chi chung byed pa yin nam snyam mo/ /du bcug nas dbang bskur na/ zhag bdun gyis gdon mi za bar ngan song gi sgrib pa las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs ni dkyus na bzhugs pa'o/ /nub mtha' ma la mi bya/ sreg pa'i tshul ni/ lam sbyang bstan gang du bya ba'i mtshams der bya ba ste/ de yang nub snga ma rnams su ni/ tshe 'das lhar gsal ba la mchod bstod byas pa'i/ nub tha ma la 'dir zas btang byed 'dod na'ang tshe 'das kyi rten la mchod bstod skabs su zas 'dod yon lngar byin gyis brlabs te 'bul zhes gsungs so/ /mjug tu lam sbyang bstan byed pa yin la/ tha ma 'dir ni mchod bstod byas rjes ming byang bsregs nas da gzod sbyang bstan byed pa yin no/ /de'i tshig ni/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ /phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ /rgyal ba lnga yi me sbar ro/ /nyon mongs lnga yi bud shing la/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi me sbar ro/ /rnam shes brgyad kyi bud shing la/ /ye shes lnga yi me sbar ro/ /oṃ ag ne ye dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes pa'i tshig 'di ka yin gsungs so/ /de legs par byas rjes sbyang bstan byas nas mjug gi bya ba rdzogs par byas te/

rgyas pa'o/ /'bring du byed na bsnyen pa dang / sa chog dor nas/ lhag ma rnams tshang bar byas pa'o/ /bsdus pa ni/ sems bskyed sdom bzung ma gtogs pa'i phyi nang gi 'jug pa mi byed par gzhan rnams byed pa ste/ de yang 'di ltar/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa mchod bstod rnams bya/ rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis bshams/ gtso bo mi snyoms sbyor dang 'khor mngal 'byin gyis bskyed/ mchod bstod bzlas pa/ zhu ba'i chur bsam pa'i bar dbang chu bzhin zhes kyang 'byung ngo / /de nas rten la rnam shes dgug gzhug cing bgegs dang sdig pa sbyangs/ sems bskyed nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa phog la bum dbang bdun bskur/ sngar dbang thob na gong ma gsum yang bskur ba dang / ma thob na nub lnga pa nas bskur ba'i tshul yang shes par bya/ de nas sdom pa bzung / khas blangs/ yon dbul nas slob ma lhar bskyed pa de logs gcig tu bzhag ste/ gtor ma nas/ tshogs 'khor dngos gzhi tshang bar byas slob ma de la'ang tshogs skal drangs so/ /mchod bstod dang lam sbyang bstan bya/ smon lam btab/ tshogs 'khor gyi mjug chog dgos pa rnams rgyas par bya ba ni bsdus pa'o/ /zhes dkyus na bzhugs/ de lta mod kyi/ bum dbang bdun gyi skabs su cho ga ji lta ba bzhin grub na legs mod kyi/ ma grub na dbang rdzas bskyed chog dgos pa rnams stabs gcig tu byas nas dbang dngos kyi tshe so so'i thad du tshigs bcad re brjod pas chog pa yin te/ 'di dang rab gnas kyi rten la dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ rten de la sdom pa 'chags pa ma yin la/ thad so so'i dgongs pa ni/ de tsam gyis grub pa'ang gsungs/ gnyis pa ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ sngar bdun tshigs tshar ba yin na mi dgos pa ste/ ma byas pa'i rten yin na/ rten bkru/ bdaṃgs/ yig bdaṃgs lhar bskyed pa/ rnam shes dgug pa nas/ mchod gtor gyi bar gong dang 'dra bar bya zhes dkyus na yod/ de nas sbyang tshul dang po la ro mchod gnas dang /

yon bdag lta bu'i sbyong tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ro de nyid lhar bskyed nas/ sreg rdzas rnams de nyid la dbul ba yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ lha gzhan bskyed nas/ ro de nyid sreg rdzas su byed nas 'bul ba yin gsungs te/ gang ltar yang thab khung bya tshul ni/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs byed na sa chog bsdus tsam bya/ thab khung khru gang dang rtsig pa mtho gang sogs blos shes par byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig rdzogs par btab/ de nas bri ba'i phyir/ thig tshon byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes thig gdab bya ste/ thab khung khru gang / zabs su brus ma brus ji ltar yang rung ste/ nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad la mtshan ma dang bcas pa bri zhes dkyus na/ de nas pha gu man chad bris nas bsreg bya ste/ de'i steng du brkyang mtho gang nas sor bzhi'i bar rtsig pa'i thog phub/ de'i steng du bum pa/ de'i steng du bre sogs byed/ bum pa'i nang du bi ril dang / bre nang du mgo bo 'ong ba yin no zhing / bum par sreg rdzas 'bul ba'i sgo dang / bre dud khung gi sgo re yang bya gsungs/ de nas nang du bud shing gzhug bgegs sbyangs te/ rol mo dang bcas pas rten nang du spyan drangs/ zhes dkyus na/ de nas pha gu tshun chad kyang rdzogs par bri ba yin la/ gal te dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs byed na/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg thab khung bris nas byed la/ de dag kyang thig mi bde na/ shog bu'am ras la tshul bzhin bris nas byed pa yin gsungs so/ /gang ltar yang de ltar grub rjes mchod gtor sogs bshams/ sreg rdzas sogs rim bzhin bsgrig go /bdag bskyed bzlas pa byas nas/ me tshang du gzhug pa ni/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ /phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ /zhes sogs brjod nas me sbar zhing / mar blugs nas me gso/ de nas thab dang yo byad bsang sogs byas/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas byon zan 'bul lo/

/mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang / sreg rdzas kyi phud kyis mchod/ lhar yang mchod bstod bdud rtsi myangs nas/ 'bar ba'i rnam par bstim/ zhes dkyus na/ de nas 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa ni/ mchod gnas ltar sbyangs pa'i lugs kyi/ thab tu rten de nyid lha dgu'i dam tshig pa bskyed pa sogs yan lag bzhi bsgrubs nas/ bdud rtsi myong zhing mchod bstod byas nas/ sreg rdzas rnams zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi tshul du phul/ slar yang bdud rtsi myang zhing / mchod bstod byas te/ yig brgyas bzod gsol dang / 'dod don gsol gdab bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor dam tshig pa dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ slar yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha gsal btab ste/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang / sreg rdzas lhag mas mchod/ yang bdud rtsi mchod bstod sogs byas/ gtor ma btang / dngos grub blangs/ lhag chad kha bskang / me lha'i ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par thim zhes dkyus na'o/ /yang sngar gson po'i dus su dbang ma thob pa'am/ thob kyang nyams pa yin na/ sbyin bdag ltar sbyong ste/ de'i tshul phal cher ni snga ma nyid dang 'dra la/ mi 'dra ba ni/ bzlas pa'i me lha'i skabs su ro lhar mi bskyed par/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yan lag bzhi bskyed pa tsam yin la/ don des na/ ro de nyid kyang sreg rdzas su byas nas 'bul ba yin te/ 'bul tshul ni/ thog mar so so'i sreg rdzas tshang bar phul/ de rjes ro de nyid spyi dang bye brag gi 'bul tshul dkyus na bzhugs pa bzhin phul/ de nas til gyi grangs ji ltar rigs pa gcig phul te/ slar yang ro de nyid tshar gcig 'bul ba yin gsungs so/ /slar 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i mchod bstod sogs nas/ bzod gsol byas te/ tshogs dang 'brel ba'i gtor ma btang zhing tshogs 'khor byas nas mjug gi cho ga rdzogs par byas te/ ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba bstan zin to/ /gsum pa mchod rten bya ba ni/

thog mar bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i bum bskyed bzlas pa byas pa'i chus rus pa rnams tshags se sogs kyi nang du a mri ta dang yig brgya brjod/ bzhag pa legs par bkrus/ de nas zhib par btags te 'jim pa dang sbyar ba'i gong bu de nyid/ rnam snang kyai rdo rje phyag bcu drug pa'am phyag gnyis pa gang rung yan lag bzhis bskyed/ de yang 'jim pa blang ba/ de zhu ba las rin po che'i phung por bsams te/ rnam snang 'od kyi rgyal po'i sngags sam/ rtsa sngags nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rten 'brel snying po sogs/ rigs sngags zab mo nang du bcug nas 'bi 'bi bya ste/ de yang 'jim pa slang ba/ 'bi 'bi bya ba/ nang du bcuṃ gzhug pa/ snum bsku ba/ rgyar bzhugs pa/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas te brdu ba/ dbyung ba/ bzhugs su gsol ba thams cad la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bh+rūm̐ aṃ dziṃ khaṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa'am/ rtsa sngags sogs ji ltar 'os pa zhig zlo bzhin pas byed la de nas rab gnas mdor bsdus byas la/ mchod bstod smon lam bya zhes dkyus na'o/ /de yang rten ngo shes pa rnams so sor bskyed/ mi shes pa rnams rdor sems su bskyed/ rigs mthun mi mthun gyi ye shes pa bcug spyan dbye byas/ zhal bsgyur brtan bzhugs sogs byed pa yin gsungs te/ gang ltar yang / sbyang ba gsum byas ma byas ji ltar yang rung la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ chos sku'i rab gnas/ de la brten nas so sor bskyed pa la sogs longs sku'i rab gnas/ zhal bsgyur te rang rang gi ji ltar 'tshams pa'i don mdzad pa sprul sku'i rab gnas te/ rab gnas gsum gyi don gsum gyi don tshang bar bya gsungs so/ /de ni mchod rten byas te sdig pa sbyong tshul mdor bstan tsam zhig gsol ba yin no/ /spyir dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyong ba la dbang gi chu bo legs par shes dgos so/ /ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyong ba la sbyin sreg gi cho ga legs par shes dgos so/

/mchod rten byas te sdig pa sbyong ba la/ rab gnas kyi cho ga legs par shes dgos so/ /de dag legs par shes pa la/ 'khrul med bla ma'i zhabs pad bsten cing / zhal gyi bdud rtsi ngoms par 'thungs nas/ phyag len gyi mthong ba brgyud pa ma nyams par longs pa zhig gnad yin par go blo gsal rab brgya'i gtsug rgyan rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i bcud kyi dga' ston las/ /cha shas thigs pas 'tsho ba'i nā gārdzu na/ /rtag tu dam pa'i mgon gyis zin par shog /don dam gnas lugs rang mtshang ma rig cing / /tha snyad cho ga tshul bzhin mi shes par/ /mthon po'i gzugs kyis rang gzhan slu'o snyam/ /bdag ni bdag nyid bsam nas spyod 'gro skyung / /kho bo tha snyad tshig gi spros pas 'jigs/ /re zhig bas mtha'i nags tshal nyams dga' der/ /ji snyed ting 'dzin bdud rtsi ma thob bar/ /sgo gsum gnad la bor te bsgom par shog /bkra shis par bya'o/ /tshar gsum khug pa'i byin rlabs sogs/ /byin rlabs dang rjes gnang kha yar bzhugs sogs/ /na gardzu na'i dpe'o/ /dge legs 'phel bkris gur+wan tu// ༈ //rgyas pa'i las sgrub dang bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rgyun gyi nyams len bzhugs so/ /tshar gsum khugs pa'i byin rlabs la/ maṇ+ḍal sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /bla ma'i sku la nas/ bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid nas/ bdag la byin rlabs bstsal du gsol gsum/ slob dpon don grub tu rgyas par gsal gdab/ phyi nang gsang ba'i tshe lha mo rnams bde ba mchog gi ngo bor 'od du zhu/ thugs kar thim par bsam/ de rnams kyi sngags la rjes zlos byas/ oṃ gu ru sogs kyi gsol btab tshar gsum/ bla ma'i dpral bar oṃ dang / phyag g.yas kyi mthil du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar yid bzhin gyi nor bu dgos 'dod 'byung ba cha brgyad pa'i lte ba'i so yig ser po'i dbus nas 'od kor oṃ yig gi phreng ba dang bcas pa byon sogs dang /

bla ma'i phyag slob ma'i dpral bar reg cing oṃ brjod/ de bzhin du mgrin thugs swa yig gi dbus dang bcas pa'i spro bsdu phyag mgrin snying du reg cing ā dang hūm̐ brjod/ gnas gsum char dang / swa yig gi dbus nas/ 'bru gsum dus gcig la byung / gnas gsum nas zhugs/ lus thams cad khengs/ gnas gsum du 'bru gsum 'khor bar bsam la phyag gnas gsum du reg cing / 'bru gsum brjod do/ /re re la 'dag bya 'thob bya dbang gi ngo sprod/ deng nas sogs 'dra// ༈ //bla ma rin 'byung / bla ma rin 'byung gi byin rlabs la maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma thengs gsum/ gang drin ma/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /bla ma mchog la bdag gsol 'debs/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po sh+lau ka gnyis dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab/ bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan du bskyed/ mchod pa la rjes zlos byed/ dpal ldan bla ma yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan sogs kyi gsol gdab tshar gsum/ bla ma'i phyag g.yas pa las/ dgos 'dod tshul bzhin du babs ring gnas khang lung pa sogs khengs/ bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par byas/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer ser po 'phros/ slob ma'i lus khyab pa'i rkyen gyis gdan lnga brtsegs kyi steng du slob ma rin 'byung du bskyed/ phyag las dgos 'dod babs rigs drug bar do bcas pa tshim par byas/ thams cad kyang rin 'byung du bsgyur/ de rnams rang sems su thag gcad/ mthar snang srid rin 'byung du gsal ba dang / bla ma 'od du zhu slob ma la thim par bsam/ 'dzin med du 'jog tu gzhug bla mas dril bu gsil zhing / a ā nas/ ai a'i bar tshar gsum/ bla ma dam pa yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan gyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la byin gyis brlab tu gsol sogs gsol ba gdab cing lta ba la bzhag deng nas sogs 'dra/ 'di gnyis chag med grub na legs te/ rje bla ma nyid ni chag med du mdzad gyin bdog gsungs so/

/ྀatshaḥ// ༈ //brda don gsal ba/ brda don gsal ba'i byin rlabs la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba lam dus gtor bsngo tsam bya yi/ rdo la bskyed chog sogs ni gang snga mi mdzad/ maṇ+ḍal gang drin sh+lau ka kun mkhyen ye shes sh+lau lo gnyis kyis gsol ba gdab/ dngos gzhi la dang po gleng gzhi'i lo rgyus bshad pa/ bar du byin gyis brlabs pa/ mthar brda don bsre zhing ngo sprad pa'o/ /dang po yi ge bzhin bshad/ gnyis pa bla ma he ru kar gsal ba dang / mdun gyi nam mkha' la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sprin phung 'thib pa bzhin bzhugs pa rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs par bsam la/ rdo slob ma'i lag tu gtad cing mgo bor bzhag ste/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan la ji ltar gdams pa'i don thams cad slob ma 'di'i rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig ces slob ma re re zhing brjod/ gsum pa ni rdo phyag tu bzung ste/ gsung ngag rin po che'i lam thams cad 'dis mtshon par nus pa yin te/ rdo dkar zhing dwangs la yid du 'ong ba 'dis/ sems kun gzhi cir yang bsgyur tu btub pa mtshon/ gru bzhi ni 'khor 'das thams cad la ris med du khyab pa/ de'i steng du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi pad+ma ni 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyis ma gos pa ltar/ kun gzhi de'i ngo bo nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gis ma gos pa mtshon/ phyogs bzhi 'dab ma stong par yod pas kun gzhi de'i ngo bo byed pa rgyu 'bras thams cad stong par mtshan pa ste mdor na shes rab lta bas thag bcad pa kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi lam thams cad mtshon/ lus thabs rgyud kyi lam dbang bzhi'i lam gyi bum dbang gi lam ni lte ba'i yi ge gnyis kyis mtshon/ gtso bo yab yum gyis mtshon pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa ste/ dang po chos nyid gdan du byas zhes pas bstan/ gsang dbang gi lam ni/ nub byang gi ya la klad kor byin pas yaṃ ni rlung gi sa bon te rlung gi sbyor ba bdun mtshon la/

gnyis pa rlung la spar zin bya zhes bstan/ lho nub kyi ra la thig les brgyan pa'i raṃ ni/ me'i sa bon te gtum mo'i dmigs pa bco brgyad bstan te/ gtum mo'i me drod rab tu bskyed ces pa bstan/ gsum pa'i lam ni shar lho'i ba la thig les brgyan pa'i baṃ ni chu'i sa bon te/ byang chub kyi sems zhu bde mi rtog pa gsum lam du byed pa ste/ byang sems chu rgyun dbang bskur gzhug ces bstan/ byang shar gyi la la thig le byin pas laṃ ni sa'i sa bon te/ des mtshon pa'i 'byung ba bzhi ba'i rba rlabs rengs pa bzhi pa'i lam ste/ sa sogs 'byung ba dbang du sdud ces pas bstan/ ye shes snga ni mngon gyur nas/ /'chi ba med pa'i gnas thob bo/ /zhes pas lam de bsgoms pas 'bras bu sku bzhi ye shes lnga thob pa ste mdor na gsung ngag rin po che'i don thams cad 'dis mtshon nus pa yin gsungs/ deng nas sogs 'dre'o// ༈ //brda chig brgyud/ brda chig brgyud kyi byin rlabs la/ maṇ+ḍal gang drin sh+lau ka dang / kun mkhyen ye shes sh+lau ka gcig gis gsol ba btab/ dpon slob thun mong du uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i srung 'khor bsgoms nas sngags bdun tsam bzlas/ de nas yol ba btang ba'i nang du slob ma re re zhing bos nas dbang bzhi'i brda rnams bslabs/ mthar thams cad la thun mong du dam la bzhag pa bzhis dam la bzhag uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i srung 'khor bsdus nas maṇ+ḍal/ slob dpon la gsol ba btab pa/ dngos gzhi brda bstan pa/ rjes dam la bzhag cing gsang bar gdams pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'o// ༈ //mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang la maṇ+ḍal gang drin ma/ sangs rgyas kun/ kun mkhyen ye shes sh+lau ka gnyis kyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum gyis rgyun bshags/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa bla ma dam pas bdag la dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa bstsal du gsol gsum/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis mdun gyi tshom bu lhar gsal ba'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i 'od kyis slob ma sbyangs pa las lhar bskyed/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs kyi skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ ḍā dril rol chen dang bcas pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi zhal nas sngags phreng byung snying ka'i hūm̐ la thims shing 'khod par bsam la/ yi ge bdun ma dang sha sa na tshar gsum/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs bya gsungs/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis rang nag po chen por gsal bar byas pa la sems gtad de/ 'di ltar gang du yang ma grub bzhin du thabs khyad par can de dag la brten nas/ rang nyid gur gyi mgon po snang stong zung 'jug gdangs 'gag med du shar ba 'dis mtshon/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang sems/ sems sgyu ma/ de rten 'brel/ de brjod bral du ngo sprad la zol med du skyong du 'jug pa thuṃgaṃsaṃ/ bla ma'i phyag phreng o ko la bskon/ gtor ma mgo bor bzhag gsung ngag brgyud pa gsum 'dus kyi bla ma'i mtshan gyi mthar bka' bsgo dkyus bzhin la/ khyad par rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams gsung ngag rin po che nyams su len pa dang gzhan la ston pa sogs thos bsam sgom gsum gyi bya ba gang byed kyang phyi rol sduṃd/ ting nge 'dzin sems/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs sogs kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ces sogs kyi bka' bsgo/ gtor ma'i lha spyi bo na bstim/ deng nas sogs 'dra/ dkyus gcig la slob ma gsum las mang ba mi mdzad/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs/ bdag chen rin po che'i yi ge ji lta ba bzhin mdzad do// ༈ //sgrub pa lung sbyin/ lam bsdus te bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa'i byin rlabs la/ maṇ+ḍal lam bsdus pa ni/

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab thams cad kyi snying po/ gsang sngags/ de'ang bla med/ de'ang kyai rdo rje/ de'i brjod bya'i don mus pa gsung ngag rin po cher gsungs shing / de'i brjod don mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par lam dus thun gcig tu 'dus pas na/ lam gyi snying po ni 'di kho na yin/ 'dus tshul yang snang ba gsum gyi nyams len thams cad ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed du 'dus/ rgyud gsum ka'i kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi nyams len thams cad ye shes tshogs bsag dang / rgyu rdor 'dzin zhu ba'i gong bu la mnyam par bzhag par 'dus/ lus thabs rgyud kyi bum dbang gi lam phyi nang gi bskyed rim dang / gsang dbang gi lam gtum mo dngos su tshang / shes rab ye shes kyi lam 'khor gyi lha mo dbyung ba dang / 'bras bu rdor 'dzin du zhengs pa'i rgyu'i snyoms 'jug tshang / der ma zad lam gyi dbang bzhi dang lam de dag rgyas par tshang ba'i phyir/ des na la la dag khyed kyis lam 'bras tshang ma'i nyams len ci thub/ lam dus ma chag tsam e yong ltos zer ba mang po yong gi gda' ste gnad ma go bar gda' gsungs/ de la chos rje rdo rje 'chang gis/ lam 'bras khrid kyi snying po ni/ sogs gsungs pa'i don la ngor pa byin la dang po nas rim bzhin brgyud pa'i 'phros ye med/ phyis su rtog bcos 'bru snon byed pa'i lab lob mang po byed pa snying po ci yang med/ rang lugs ring brgyud dang nye brgyud gnyis las 'ongs pa'i nyams su blang bya'i gtso bo mngon rtogs dang lam dus kyi dbang chog gnyis yin la/ de las gsum 'byung ba ni/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ste/ mngon rtogs rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa/ 'bring drug pa/ bsdus pa ni/ sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rjes su gzhan med par tshad med bzhi bsgoms nas ye shes tshogs bsag byas/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/

rgyan rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ lha so so'i gdan dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ rang rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du gsal ba'i zhes pa'i bar lam gyis sgom pas chog gi re re nas gsal 'debs mi dgos/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs yan dkyus bzhin la/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs don dran bzhin pas oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho lan gsum brjod pas rung gsungs/ dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ni dkyus ltar/ dngos kyi tshe rig pa'i dbang lnga rdo rje brtul zhugs dang drug dam tshig gsum dang bcas pa thob byung snyam pa'i nges shes/ gsang dbang gi lce thog tu myang pas lus khengs pa dang / gsum pa'i tshe dri ba dres lan sngon du 'gro bas snyom par zhugs/ dga' bzhi lugs ldog tu skyes byung snyam pa'i nges shes/ yid ches pa re bskyed dgos gsungs/ mtshon bya don gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes yod na 'das pa'i rtog pa 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes/ da ltar gyi rig pa skad cig la dbang gis tshang ba yin/ gsal ba'i cha bum dbang / stong pa'i cha gsang dbang / dbyer med pa gsum pa/ de'i ngo bo blo las 'das pa bzhi pa ste mdor na chu la sogs pas rab bkrus bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dbang gi chu bo rab ye shes/ 'bring nges shes/ mtha' ma tshig la bzhag pa'i bar ye shes rgyud la skyes na legs te/ skyes kyang dbang de dang de thob dri ma de dang de dga' thob bya de dang de mngon du byas pa yin snyam pa'i nges shes ma skyes na/ shar sbyangs tsam gyis dpe don gyis chu'o nub 'gro bas nan tan cher bya gsung / gnyis pa lung phyin pa ni/ nyams su blangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa la gsang ba bcus rgyas btab ste/ skal mngon sum skal ldan la phan pa 'di la gsum/ dus khyad par can la mkha' 'gro lnga mnyes par bya ba/ lung sbyin pa dngos/ rjes bka' rgyas btab pa'o/ /dang po ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo cho ga ji lta bar bsgrubs tshar ba des 'thus/

gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /khyed kyi thugs rje'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol gsum/ bla ma zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid khyab bdag he ru ka phyag bcu drug ral gri'i steng gi cha la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang yab yum mthu stobs dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras sogs gsung ngag brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi bla ma rnams mngon sum du bzhugs pa de dag gi mtha' skor du yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po la sogs pa chos skyong srung ma thams cad dgyes bzhin du sprin phung ltar 'thibs se bzhugs pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu khyed rang la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i lung byin byung snyam du mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkyil 'khor lnga la btud de bkruṃn zhes pa nas bde chen chos sku nam mkha' mthong / /bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /tshar gcig rdo rje 'chang nas bla ma rnams kyi mtshan rim bzhin brjod de/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma blo ldan shes rab kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bka' drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i zhal snga nas sogs kyis bdag la gnang ba'i bar dang gzhan yang bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ yab 'jam dbyangs chen po la gsan pa dang / 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po la gsan pa sogs brgyud pa gsum 'dus kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyis gsung ngag rin po che nyams su len pa la 'jig rten chos kyi bar chad/ phyi rol bdud kyi bdud stobs 'phel ba'i bar chad la sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad las rgyal ba de bzhin du 'dir rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams sus gsung ngag rin po che nyams su len pa la/

'jig rten chos dang la sogs pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig ces tshar gcig brjod cing me tog gtor/ des bar chad mi 'byung ba'i lung thob pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad khyed rang rnams kyis bshad sgrub gang byed kyang bar chad mi 'byung bar nges pa yin no gsungs/ yan chad de dag gis sgrub pa'i lung byin byung snyam pas/ dkyil 'khor lnga nas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol tshar gcig rdo rje 'chang nas rnams gsung ngag rin po che nyams su len pa'i tshe zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa bzhin du sogs/ des sgrub pa'i lung thob pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad sngar dang mi 'dra bar zung 'jug gi rtogs pa khyad par du byas pa rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ro gsungs so/ /yan chad de dag gis mgrin gcig tu bshad pa'i lung byin byung snyam pas/ dkyil 'khor lnga nas brlab tu gsol tshar gcig rdo rje 'chang nas de dag gis sgrub pa mthar phyin pa'i rjes su sems can gyi don bsam gyis mi khyab pa grub pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyang sgrub pa mthar phyin nas gzhan don bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'grub par gyur cig ces tshar gcig dang / me tog 'thor/ de ltar byas pas bshad pa'i lung thob pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad gzhan la 'chad pa'i tshe rang gzhan la gegs dang bar chad mi 'byung ba bzhin rgyud smin par nus pa sogs gzhan don mtshan nyid pa 'grub pa yin no/ /des na bar chad med pa bsgrub pa bshad pa'i lung rnams byin pa la brten nas/ khyed rang rnams nyams su len pa dang gzhan la ston pa sogs gang byed kyang rang dbang thob ste/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs ye mi 'byung zhing / mthun rkyen 'bad med du 'byung bar bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pas zhal gyis bzhes pa yin pas/ de dag gi zhaṃl lceṃs bskuṃl baṃ'i chos 'chad pa sogs kyi tshe gsol ba 'debs par byed pa yin/

gsum pa ni/ dam du sba zhing dam du spel zhes gsungs pas byung rgyal du mi 'chad par snod brtags te rim bzhin du ston dgos pas/ snod ma brtags par dbang mi bskur/ dbang ma bskur bar khrid mi ston/ khrid ma bstan par gdam ngag mi bstan te gzhung bshad mi ston/ gdam ngag mi ston par bka' rgyas mi 'debs pa yin gsungs nas gsang bcu'i gdam ngag yi ge bzhin gsungs so/ ྀatshaḥ'adi rnams khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho'i gsung / thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtshos zin bris su mdzad pa'o/ /dge'o bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ lam zab sbas don snying po/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
